bugs.rule: SECURITY BUG: FindCare proxy endpoints (/evaluate/splash, /transfer/to-findcare) called EvaluateCare over HTTPS without presenting client certificates. This bypasses mutual TLS authentication. Any service-to-service call without mTLS is a NIST 800-53 SC-8 (Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity) and HITRUST 09.m finding. All inter-service communication MUST use mTLS with the calling service presenting its own cert and verifying the target against the CA.
bugs.description: FindCare proxy to EvaluateCare did not use mTLS â€” security finding under NIST 800-53 SC-8 and HITRUST 09.m.
bugs.reason: Proxy endpoints were written before mTLS was implemented. Never updated to present client certificates.

bugs.reason: When any component (FindCare, EvaluateCare, or SharedServices) creates a new nonce during handoff, both panels must show identical session verification with matching nonce and GUID. They do not.
bugs.title: Session verification display not identical across panels after component handoff
bugs.description: After a component handoff between any of the three components (FindCare, EvaluateCare, SharedServices), the receiving component creates a fresh nonce. The right panel updates with the verified token but the left panel still shows the old nonce. Both panels must display identical session verification: same header, same nonce, same GUID, same verified status. There are 6 possible handoffs (n*(n-1) = 3*2 = 6): (1) FindCare to EvaluateCare, (2) FindCare to SharedServices, (3) EvaluateCare to FindCare, (4) EvaluateCare to SharedServices, (5) SharedServices to FindCare, (6) SharedServices to EvaluateCare. Each must produce identical session verification in both panels.
bugs.root_cause: gui:session-display is sent once before handoff with the raw token. After the component returns a verified token with a new nonce, the left panel handler, which must be the component that has control, is never updated. It also uses a different display format than buildTokenDisplayHtml().
bugs.fix: After each component handoff returns a verified token, send gui:session-display with the full session_token object. Update the handler to use buildTokenDisplayHtml() for identical display. Applies to all three components: FindCare, EvaluateCare, SharedServices. Permutations formula n*(n-1) = 3*2 = 6 possible handoffs. The Playwright smoke test must verify session identity after each: (1) FindCare to EvaluateCare, (2) FindCare to SharedServices, (3) EvaluateCare to FindCare, (4) EvaluateCare to SharedServices, (5) SharedServices to FindCare, (6) SharedServices to EvaluateCare.
bugs.expected: After any component handoff, both panels show identical session verification with the same nonce and GUID.
bugs.actual: Left panel shows stale nonce and simplified display. Right panel shows correct verified token with new nonce.
bugs.next_action: verify fix with Playwright step 17
